name: Barcelona Cruise Port
overview_text: Barcelona is Europe's leading cruise turnaround hub, operating seven international passenger terminals primarily concentrated along Moll Adossat.
getting_around: The official T3 Cruise Bus connects Moll Adossat terminals to the Columbus Monument at the foot of La Rambla. From there, Metro Line L3 (Drassanes) connects to all central attractions.
all_aboard_warning: Terminals on Moll Adossat are 2 to 4.5 km from the city center across the high Porta d'Europa bridge. Allow at least 45-60 minutes to return from the city center to your terminal.

terminals.name: Moll Adossat - Terminal A
terminals.description: International mega-cruise terminal handling turnaround and transit operations.

terminals.name: Moll Adossat - Terminal B
terminals.description: International mega-cruise terminal handling turnaround and transit operations.

terminals.name: Moll Adossat - Terminal C
terminals.description: International passenger terminal on Moll Adossat.

terminals.name: Moll Adossat - Terminal D (Palacruceros)
terminals.description: Dedicated Carnival Corporation and Costa Cruises terminal facility.

terminals.name: Moll Adossat - Terminal E (Helix Cruise Center)
terminals.description: Modern high-capacity Carnival Corporation terminal facility.

terminals.name: Moll Adossat - Terminal H (MSC)
terminals.description: New state-of-the-art flagship terminal for MSC Cruises featuring pre-installed shore power OPS connections.

terminals.name: World Trade Center - Terminal South (S)
terminals.description: Dedicated boutique and small luxury cruise terminal. Scheduled to close at the end of 2026 to consolidate all cruise operations at Moll Adossat.

terminals.name: World Trade Center - Terminal North (N)
terminals.description: Boutique terminal closed at the end of 2023 under the city consolidation agreement.

berths.name: Moll Adossat Berths A-H
berths.notes: Accommodates up to 7 mega-cruise vessels simultaneously with direct alongside docking.

berths.name: WTC Barcelona Berths
berths.notes: Dedicated to boutique vessels under 200m in length.

arrival_procedures: Direct-dock port. Customs, immigration, and security checkpoints are located inside each individual terminal building. Ground floors handle baggage claim, check-in, and security scanners.
departure_procedures: Highly efficient processing. Outside the terminal doors, dedicated transport zones organize taxi ranks, cruise line motorcoaches, and public shuttle staging.

walking_feasibility.rating: Not Recommended from Moll Adossat; Highly Walkable from WTCB
walking_feasibility.description: Moll Adossat is 2 to 4.5 km from the city center across the high Porta d'Europa industrial bridge with heavy traffic. WTCB allows walking directly into La Rambla in 10-15 minutes.
